verdict.rationale: AMD's product page confirms FSR 'Redstone' support for the RX 9070 XT, but the evidence pack provides no documentation on generation-by-generation feature breakdown, frame generation specifics, or broad per-game compatibility lists. Missing for 10: documented list of supported games, comparison of FSR frame-gen vs DLSS-equivalent features, and independent hands-on confirmation of game-by-game support breadth.
